newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville offers 500 MW peak power for Tues, Wed.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville offers 500 MW peak power for Tues, Wed.

text.p: Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) was offering up to 500 megawatts of peak load power for Tuesday and Wednesday delivery at $31.50 per megawatt hour (MWh), the federal agency said Monday.
BPA was also offering peak power for Tuesday and Wednesday in the Northwest at $32.00 per MWh and at $32.75 per MWh at California Oregon Border/Nevada Oregon Border (COB/NOB), the agency said.
The offer marked a price increase for the agency, which had offered Saturday and Monday on-peak firm electricity at $30.00 in the Northwest and $30.75 for COB with an 800 MW limit.
Peak firm power for Sunday had been priced at $28.00 for Northwest deals and $28.75 for COB.
